Today, we're introducing Saved Views, a new way to work faster in your projects. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a list, you can now save your exact setup and return to it in one click. Saved Views is available today and included in all paid plans, so every subscriber can start using it right away at no extra cost.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, priority, status, or personal preference. Need to keep everyone aligned? Views can be shared with your team, so teammates see the same filtered lists without recreating them from scratch. This makes standups, sprint planning, and status reviews faster, since everyone works from a consistent, shared perspective.

We built this feature based on direct customer feedback, and we're continuing to refine it in the weeks ahead. Try it out and let us know what you think.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
